verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן וּלְאַבְשָׁל֧וֹם בֶּן־ דָּוִ֛ד אָח֥וֹת יָפָ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֣הּ תָּמָ֑ר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶ֖הָ אַמְנ֥וֹן בֶּן־ דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên ū·lə·’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ben- dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḥō·wṯ yā·p̄āh ū·šə·māh tā·mār way·ye·’ĕ·hā·ḇe·hā ’am·nō·wn ben- dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: After some time . . . . . . David’s son Amnon fell in love with Tamar the beautiful sister of David’s son Absalom
verses.literalPt: Aconteceu depois disso que, tendo Absalão, filho de Davi, uma irmã formosa, que se chamava Tamar; Amnom, filho de Davi, namorou-se dela.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨צֶר לְאַמְנ֜וֹן לְהִתְחַלּ֗וֹת בַּֽעֲבוּר֙ תָּמָ֣ר אֲחֹת֔וֹ כִּ֥י בְתוּלָ֖ה הִ֑יא וַיִּפָּלֵא֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י אַמְנ֔וֹן לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֖הּ מְאֽוּמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣer lə·’am·nō·wn lə·hiṯ·ḥal·lō·wṯ ba·‘ă·ḇūr tā·mār ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw kî ḇə·ṯū·lāh hî way·yip·pā·lê bə·‘ê·nê ’am·nō·wn la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lāh mə·’ū·māh
verses.literal: Amnon was sick with frustration over his sister Tamar for she was a virgin and it seemed implausible for him to do anything to her
verses.literalPt: Angustiou-se Amnom, de maneira que adoeceu por causa de sua irmã Tamar, porque era virgem, e parecia difícil a Amnom fazer-lhe alguma coisa.

verses.original: וּלְאַמְנ֣וֹן רֵ֗עַ וּשְׁמוֹ֙ יֽוֹנָדָ֔ב בֶּן־ שִׁמְעָ֖ה אֲחִ֣י דָוִ֑ד וְי֣וֹנָדָ֔ב אִ֥ישׁ חָכָ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’am·nō·wn rê·a‘ ū·šə·mōw yō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- šim·‘āh ’ă·ḥî ḏā·wiḏ wə·yō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ’îš ḥā·ḵām mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Now Amnon had a friend named Jonadab the son of David’s brother Shimeah Jonadab was a very shrewd man
verses.literalPt: Tinha, porém, Amnom um amigo que se chamava Jonadabe, filho de Simeia, irmão de Davi. Era Jonadabe homem mui sagaz.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ מַדּ֣וּעַ אַ֠תָּה כָּ֣כָה דַּ֤ל בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֔קֶר הֲל֖וֹא תַּגִּ֣יד לִ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אַמְנ֔וֹן אֶת־ תָּמָ֗ר אֲח֛וֹת אַבְשָׁלֹ֥ם אָחִ֖י אֲנִ֥י אֹהֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw mad·dū·a‘ ’at·tāh kā·ḵāh dal ben- ham·me·leḵ bab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer hă·lō·w tag·gîḏ lî way·yō·mer lōw ’am·nō·wn ’eṯ- tā·mār ’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’aḇ·šā·lōm ’ā·ḥî ’ă·nî ’ō·hêḇ
verses.literal: and he asked Amnon Why are you the son of the king so depressed morning after morning Won’t you tell me Amnon replied I am in love with Tamar my brother Absalom’s sister
verses.literalPt: Este lhe perguntou: Por que vais tu emagrecendo de dia para dia, ó filho do rei? Não mo dirás? Respondeu-lhe Amnom: Eu amo a Tamar, irmã de meu irmão Absalão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ יְה֣וֹנָדָ֔ב שְׁכַ֥ב עַל־ מִשְׁכָּבְךָ֖ וְהִתְחָ֑ל וּבָ֧א אָבִ֣יךָ לִרְאוֹתֶ֗ךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֡יו תָּ֣בֹא נָא֩ תָמָ֨ר אֲחוֹתִ֜י וְתַבְרֵ֣נִי לֶ֗חֶם וְעָשְׂתָ֤ה לְעֵינַי֙ אֶת־ הַבִּרְיָ֔ה לְמַ֙עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶרְאֶ֔ה וְאָכַלְתִּ֖י מִיָּדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ šə·ḵaḇ ‘al- miš·kā·ḇə·ḵā wə·hiṯ·ḥāl ū·ḇā ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lir·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw tā·ḇō nā ṯā·mār ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯî wə·ṯaḇ·rê·nî le·ḥem wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh lə·‘ê·nay ’eṯ- hab·bir·yāh lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer ’er·’eh wə·’ā·ḵal·tî mî·yā·ḏāh
verses.literal: Jonadab told him Lie down on your bed and pretend you are ill When your father comes to see you say to him Please let my sister Tamar come and give me something to eat Let her prepare it in my sight so I may watch her and eat it from her hand
verses.literalPt: Tornou-lhe Jonadabe: Deita-te na tua cama e finge que estás doente; e, quando teu pai te vier visitar, dize-lhe: Rogo-te que venha minha irmã Tamar e me dê de comer, preparando a comida diante dos meus olhos, para que eu veja e coma da sua mão.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אַמְנ֖וֹן וַיִּתְחָ֑ל וַיָּבֹ֨א הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לִרְאֹת֗וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַמְנ֤וֹן אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ תָּֽבוֹא־ נָ֞א תָּמָ֣ר אֲחֹתִ֗י וּתְלַבֵּ֤ב לְעֵינַי֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י לְבִב֔וֹת וְאֶבְרֶ֖ה מִיָּדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ’am·nō·wn way·yiṯ·ḥāl way·yā·ḇō ham·me·leḵ lir·’ō·ṯōw way·yō·mer ’am·nō·wn ’el- ham·me·leḵ tā·ḇō·w- nā tā·mār ’ă·ḥō·ṯî ū·ṯə·lab·bêḇ lə·‘ê·nay šə·tê lə·ḇi·ḇō·wṯ wə·’eḇ·reh mî·yā·ḏāh
verses.literal: So Amnon lay down and feigned illness When the king came to see him Amnon said - Please let my sister . . . Tamar come and make a couple of cakes in my sight so that I may eat from her hand
verses.literalPt: Deitou-se Amnom na cama e fingiu que estava doente. Tendo vindo o rei visitá-lo, disse-lhe Amnom: Rogo-te que venha minha irmã Tamar e me faça diante dos meus olhos dois bolos, para que eu coma da sua mão.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶל־ תָּמָ֖ר הַבַּ֣יְתָה לֵאמֹ֑ר לְכִ֣י נָ֗א בֵּ֚ית אַמְנ֣וֹן אָחִ֔יךְ וַעֲשִׂי־ ל֖וֹ הַבִּרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ dā·wiḏ ’el- tā·mār hab·bay·ṯāh lê·mōr lə·ḵî nā bêṯ ’am·nō·wn ’ā·ḥîḵ wa·‘ă·śî- lōw hab·bir·yāh
verses.literal: Then David sent word to Tamar at the palace . . . Please go to the house of Amnon your brother and prepare a meal for him
verses.literalPt: Mandou Davi à casa de Tamar, a dizer-lhe: Vai à casa de teu irmão Amnom e faze-lhe comida.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֗ר בֵּ֛ית אַמְנ֥וֹן אָחִ֖יהָ וְה֣וּא שֹׁכֵ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֨ח אֶת־ הַבָּצֵ֤ק וַתָּלוֹשׁ וַתְּלַבֵּ֣ב לְעֵינָ֔יו וַתְּבַשֵּׁ֖ל אֶת־ הַלְּבִבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ tā·mār bêṯ ’am·nō·wn ’ā·ḥî·hā wə·hū šō·ḵêḇ wat·tiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hab·bā·ṣêq wat·tå̄·lōš wat·tə·lab·bêḇ lə·‘ê·nāw wat·tə·ḇaš·šêl ’eṯ- hal·lə·ḇi·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon who was lying down She took some dough kneaded it made cakes in his sight and baked them
verses.literalPt: Foi Tamar à casa de seu irmão Amnom; e ele estava deitado. Ela, tomando massa, a amassou, fez bolos diante dele e os cozeu.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הַמַּשְׂרֵת֙ וַתִּצֹ֣ק לְפָנָ֔יו וַיְמָאֵ֖ן לֶאֱכ֑וֹל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַמְנ֗וֹן הוֹצִ֤יאוּ כָל־ אִישׁ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י וַיֵּצְא֥וּ כָל־ אִ֖ישׁ מֵעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ham·maś·rêṯ wat·ti·ṣōq lə·p̄ā·nāw way·mā·’ên le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl way·yō·mer ’am·nō·wn hō·w·ṣî·’ū ḵāl ’îš mê·‘ā·lay way·yê·ṣə·’ū ḵāl ’îš mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Then she brought the pan and set it down before him but he refused to eat Send everyone . . . . . . away said Amnon And everyone . . . . . . went out
verses.literalPt: Tomou a panela e tirou os bolos à sua vista; mas ele recusou comer. Disse Amnom: Façam retirar todos da minha presença. Todos se retiraram.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַמְנ֜וֹן אֶל־ תָּמָ֗ר הָבִ֤יאִי הַבִּרְיָה֙ הַחֶ֔דֶר וְאֶבְרֶ֖ה מִיָּדֵ֑ךְ וַתִּקַּ֣ח תָּמָ֗ר אֶת־ הַלְּבִבוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔תָה וַתָּבֵ֛א לְאַמְנ֥וֹן אָחִ֖יהָ הֶחָֽדְרָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’am·nō·wn ’el- tā·mār hā·ḇî·’î hab·bir·yāh ha·ḥe·ḏer wə·’eḇ·reh mî·yā·ḏêḵ wat·tiq·qaḥ tā·mār ’eṯ- hal·lə·ḇi·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śā·ṯāh wat·tā·ḇê lə·’am·nō·wn ’ā·ḥî·hā he·ḥā·ḏə·rāh
verses.literal: Then Amnon said to Tamar Bring the food into the bedroom so that I may eat it from your hand Tamar took the cakes she had made and went to her brother Amnon’s bedroom
verses.literalPt: Disse Amnom a Tamar: Traze a comida à câmara, para que eu coma da tua mão. Tomou Tamar os bolos que tinha preparado e os trouxe à câmara a seu irmão Amnom.

verses.original: וַתַּגֵּ֥שׁ אֵלָ֖יו לֶֽאֱכֹ֑ל וַיַּֽחֲזֶק־ בָּהּ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֔הּ בּ֛וֹאִי שִׁכְבִ֥י עִמִּ֖י אֲחוֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tag·gêš ’ê·lāw le·’ĕ·ḵōl way·ya·ḥă·zeq- bāh way·yō·mer lāh bō·w·’î šiḵ·ḇî ‘im·mî ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: And when she had brought them to him to eat he took hold of her and said Come lie with me my sister
verses.literalPt: Quando Tamar lhos havia chegado, para que ele comesse, Amnom pegou dela e disse-lhe: Vem, deita-te comigo, minha irmã.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אַל־ אָחִי֙ אַל־ תְּעַנֵּ֔נִי כִּ֛י לֹא־ יֵֽעָשֶׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַֽל־ תַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה אֶת־ הַנְּבָלָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lōw ’al- ’ā·ḥî ’al- tə·‘an·nê·nî kî lō- yê·‘ā·śeh ḵên bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’al- ta·‘ă·śêh ’eṯ- han·nə·ḇā·lāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: No my brother she cried Do not violate me for such a thing should never be done in Israel Do not do this disgraceful thing
verses.literalPt: Porém ela lhe respondeu: Não, meu irmão, não me faças essa violência, pois não se faz assim em Israel. Não cometas essa loucura.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י אָ֤נָה אוֹלִיךְ֙ אֶת־ חֶרְפָּתִ֔י וְאַתָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֛ה כְּאַחַ֥ד הַנְּבָלִ֖ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּה֙ דַּבֶּר־ נָ֣א אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִמְנָעֵ֖נִי מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·nāh ’ō·w·lîḵ ’eṯ- ḥer·pā·ṯî wə·’at·tāh tih·yeh kə·’a·ḥaḏ han·nə·ḇā·lîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘at·tāh dab·ber- nā ’el- ham·me·leḵ kî lō yim·nā·‘ê·nî mim·me·kā
verses.literal: Where could I ever take my shame And you would be like one of the fools in Israel . . . Please speak to the king for he will not withhold me from you
verses.literalPt: Eu, para onde poderia levar o meu opróbrio? E tu passarias em Israel por um louco. Agora, fala ao rei, porque ele não me negará a ti.

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ בְּקוֹלָ֑הּ וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִמֶּ֙נָּה֙ וַיְעַנֶּ֔הָ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh liš·mō·a‘ bə·qō·w·lāh way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq mim·men·nāh way·‘an·ne·hā way·yiš·kaḇ ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: But Amnon refused . . . to listen to her . . . and being stronger . . . he violated her and lay with her
verses.literalPt: Todavia, ele não quis dar ouvidos à sua voz; antes, sendo mais forte do que ela, forçou-a e deitou-se com ela.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂנָאֶ֣הָ אַמְנ֗וֹן שִׂנְאָה֙ גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד כִּ֣י גְדוֹלָ֗ה הַשִּׂנְאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׂנֵאָ֔הּ מֵאַהֲבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲהֵבָ֑הּ וַֽיֹּאמֶר־ לָ֥הּ אַמְנ֖וֹן ק֥וּמִי לֵֽכִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·nā·’e·hā ’am·nō·wn śin·’āh gə·ḏō·w·lāh mə·’ōḏ kî ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh haś·śin·’āh ’ă·šer śə·nê·’āh mê·’a·hă·ḇāh ’ă·šer ’ă·hê·ḇāh way·yō·mer- lāh ’am·nō·wn qū·mî lê·ḵî
verses.literal: Then Amnon hated Tamar with such intensity . . . that his hatred . . . was greater than . . . the love he previously had Get up he said to her Be gone
verses.literalPt: Amnom sentiu por ela grande aversão, pois maior era a aversão que sentiu por ela do que o amor que lhe votara. Amnom disse-lhe: Levanta-te e vai-te embora.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אַל־ אוֹדֹ֞ת הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את מֵאַחֶ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתָ עִמִּ֖י לְשַׁלְּחֵ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁמֹ֥עַֽ לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lōw ’al- ’ō·w·ḏōṯ hā·rā·‘āh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh haz·zōṯ mê·’a·ḥe·reṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘im·mî lə·šal·lə·ḥê·nî wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh liš·mō·a‘ lāh
verses.literal: No . . . she replied sending me away is worse than this great wrong you have already done to me But he refused . . . to listen to her
verses.literalPt: Ela lhe respondeu: Não, meu irmão; porque maior é essa injúria, lançando-me fora, do que a outra que me fizeste. Porém ele não a quis ouvir.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶֽת־ נַעֲרוֹ֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁלְחוּ־ נָ֥א אֶת־ זֹ֛את מֵעָלַ֖י הַח֑וּצָה וּנְעֹ֥ל הַדֶּ֖לֶת אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- na·‘ă·rōw mə·šā·rə·ṯōw way·yō·mer šil·ḥū- nā ’eṯ- zōṯ mê·‘ā·lay ha·ḥū·ṣāh ū·nə·‘ōl had·de·leṯ ’a·ḥă·re·hā
verses.literal: Instead, he called to his attendant . . . and said Throw . . . this woman . . . out and bolt the door behind her
verses.literalPt: Chamou ao seu servo que lhe assistia e disse: Deita fora a esta mulher e fecha bem a porta após ela.

verses.original: וְעָלֶ֙יהָ֙ כְּתֹ֣נֶת פַּסִּ֔ים כִּי֩ כֵ֨ן תִּלְבַּ֧שְׁןָ בְנוֹת־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ הַבְּתוּלֹ֖ת מְעִילִ֑ים וַיֹּצֵ֨א אוֹתָ֤הּ מְשָֽׁרְתוֹ֙ הַח֔וּץ וְנָעַ֥ל הַדֶּ֖לֶת אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·le·hā kə·ṯō·neṯ pas·sîm kî ḵên til·baš·nā ḇə·nō·wṯ- ham·me·leḵ hab·bə·ṯū·lōṯ mə·‘î·lîm way·yō·ṣê ’ō·w·ṯāh mə·šā·rə·ṯōw ha·ḥūṣ wə·nā·‘al had·de·leṯ ’a·ḥă·re·hā
verses.literal: So Amnon’s attendant threw her out and bolted the door behind her Now Tamar was wearing a robe of many colors because this is what the king’s virgin . . . daughters wore
verses.literalPt: Ela trazia uma túnica talar com mangas compridas, porque este era o trajo de que usavam as donzelas filhas de rei. O servo de Amnom deitou-a fora e fechou bem a porta após ela.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֨ח תָּמָ֥ר אֵ֙פֶר֙ עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וּכְתֹ֧נֶת הַפַּסִּ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלֶ֖יהָ קָרָ֑עָה וַתָּ֤שֶׂם יָדָהּ֙ עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֖וֹךְ וְזָעָֽקָה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ tā·mār ’ê·p̄er ‘al- rō·šāh ū·ḵə·ṯō·neṯ hap·pas·sîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·le·hā qā·rā·‘āh wat·tā·śem yā·ḏāh ‘al- rō·šāh wat·tê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ wə·zā·‘ā·qāh
verses.literal: And Tamar put ashes on her head and tore her robe And putting her hand on her head she went away . . . crying aloud
verses.literalPt: Tamar lançou cinzas sobre a cabeça, rasgou a túnica talar com mangas compridas e, postas as mãos na cabeça, foi-se dali gritando.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֜יהָ אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם אָחִ֗יהָ הַאֲמִינ֣וֹן אָחִיךְ֮ הָיָ֣ה עִמָּךְ֒ וְעַתָּ֞ה אֲחוֹתִ֤י הַחֲרִ֙ישִׁי֙ אָחִ֣יךְ ה֔וּא אַל־ תָּשִׁ֥יתִי אֶת־ לִבֵּ֖ךְ לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב תָּמָר֙ וְשֹׁ֣מֵמָ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אַבְשָׁל֥וֹם אָחִֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’ā·ḥî·hā ha·’ă·mî·nō·wn ’ā·ḥîḵ hā·yāh ‘im·māḵ wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯî ha·ḥă·rî·šî ’ā·ḥîḵ hū ’al- tā·šî·ṯî ’eṯ- lib·bêḵ lad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wat·tê·šeḇ tā·mār wə·šō·mê·māh bêṯ ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’ā·ḥî·hā
verses.literal: Her brother Absalom said to her Has your brother Amnon been with you Be quiet for now my sister He is your brother Do not take this thing to heart So Tamar lived as a desolate woman in the house of her brother Absalom
verses.literalPt: Absalão, seu irmão, disse-lhe: Esteve contigo Amnom, teu irmão? Agora, minha irmã, cala-te. É teu irmão; não te angustie o coração por isso. Ficou Tamar desolada na casa de seu irmão Absalão.

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד שָׁמַ֕ע אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיִּ֥חַר ל֖וֹ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ šā·ma‘ ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·yi·ḥar lōw mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: When King David heard all this he was furious . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando o rei Davi ouviu todas essas coisas, muito se lhe acendeu a ira.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ דִבֶּ֧ר אַבְשָׁל֛וֹם עִם־ אַמְנ֖וֹן לְמֵרָ֣ע וְעַד־ ט֑וֹב כִּֽי־ שָׂנֵ֤א אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶת־ אַמְנ֔וֹן עַל־ דְּבַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִנָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת תָּמָ֥ר אֲחֹתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ḏib·ber ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ‘im- ’am·nō·wn lə·mê·rā‘ wə·‘aḏ- ṭō·wḇ kî- śā·nê ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’eṯ- ’am·nō·wn ‘al- də·ḇar ’ă·šer ‘in·nāh ’êṯ tā·mār ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw
verses.literal: And Absalom never said a word to Amnon either good or bad . . . because he hated Amnon for . . . violating his sister Tamar
verses.literalPt: Absalão não falou a Amnom nem mal nem bem, porque Absalão aborrecia a Amnom por ter ele violado a Tamar, sua irmã.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִשְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֤וּ גֹֽזְזִים֙ לְאַבְשָׁל֔וֹם בְּבַ֥עַל חָצ֖וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִם־ אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיִּקְרָ֥א אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî liš·nā·ṯa·yim yā·mîm way·yih·yū ḡō·zə·zîm lə·’aḇ·šā·lō·wm bə·ḇa·‘al ḥā·ṣō·wr ’ă·šer ‘im- ’ep̄·rā·yim way·yiq·rā ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm lə·ḵāl bə·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Two years later . . . . . . when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal-hazor near Ephraim he invited all the sons of the king
verses.literalPt: Passados dois anos, Absalão fazia a sua tosquia em Baal-Hazor, que está perto de Efraim, e convidou todos os filhos do rei.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה־ נָ֥א גֹזְזִ֖ים לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ יֵֽלֶךְ־ נָ֥א הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וַעֲבָדָ֖יו עִם־ עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer hin·nêh- nā ḡō·zə·zîm lə·‘aḇ·de·ḵā yê·leḵ- nā ham·me·leḵ wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ‘im- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: And he went to the king and said Your servant has just hired shearers Will the king and his servants please come with me
verses.literalPt: Absalão foi ter com o rei e disse: Eis que agora o teu servo faz a tosquia. Venham o rei e os seus servos com o teu servo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל־ אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם אַל־ בְּנִי֙ אַל־ נָ֤א נֵלֵךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וְלֹ֥א נִכְבַּ֖ד עָלֶ֑יךָ וַיִּפְרָץ־ בּ֛וֹ וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֥ה לָלֶ֖כֶת וַֽיְבָרֲכֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’al- bə·nî ’al- nā nê·lêḵ kul·lā·nū wə·lō niḵ·baḏ ‘ā·le·ḵā way·yip̄·rāṣ- bōw wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh lā·le·ḵeṯ way·ḇā·ră·ḵê·hū
verses.literal: No my son the king replied - we should not . . . all go or we would be a burden to you Although Absalom urged him he was not willing to go but gave him his blessing
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o rei a Absalão: Não, meu filho, não vamos todos, para não suceder que te sejamos pesados. Absalão instou com ele; todavia, ele não quis ir, mas deu-lhe a sua bênção.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם וָלֹ֕א יֵֽלֶךְ־ נָ֥א אִתָּ֖נוּ אַמְנ֣וֹן אָחִ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֥מָּה יֵלֵ֖ךְ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm wā·lō yê·leḵ- nā ’it·tā·nū ’am·nō·wn ’ā·ḥî way·yō·mer lōw ham·me·leḵ lām·māh yê·lêḵ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: If not said Absalom please let my brother Amnon go with us Why should he go with you the king asked
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Absalão: Rogo-te que ao menos venha conosco meu irmão Amnom. Perguntou-lhe o rei: Para que iria ele contigo?

verses.original: וַיִּפְרָץ־ בּ֖וֹ אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אִתּוֹ֙ אֶת־ אַמְנ֔וֹן וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·rāṣ- bōw ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm way·yiš·laḥ ’it·tōw ’eṯ- ’am·nō·wn wə·’êṯ kāl- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: But Absalom urged him so the king sent . . . Amnon and the rest of his sons
verses.literalPt: Instando Absalão com ele, Davi deixou ir com ele Amnom e todos os mais filhos do rei.

verses.original: וַיְצַו֩ אַבְשָׁל֨וֹם אֶת־ נְעָרָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר רְא֣וּ נָ֠א כְּט֨וֹב לֵב־ אַמְנ֤וֹן בַּיַּ֙יִן֙ וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם הַכּ֧וּ אֶת־ אַמְנ֛וֹן וַהֲמִתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ אַל־ תִּירָ֑אוּ הֲל֗וֹא כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶתְכֶ֔ם חִזְק֖וּ וִהְי֥וּ לִבְנֵי־ חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’eṯ- nə·‘ā·rāw lê·mōr rə·’ū nā kə·ṭō·wḇ lêḇ- ’am·nō·wn bay·ya·yin wə·’ā·mar·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem hak·kū ’eṯ- ’am·nō·wn wa·hă·mit·tem ’ō·ṯōw ’al- tî·rā·’ū hă·lō·w kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem ḥiz·qū wih·yū liḇ·nê- ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Now Absalom had ordered his young men Watch Amnon until his heart is merry with wine and when I order you to strike Amnon down you are to kill him Do not be afraid Have I not commanded you Be courageous and valiant
verses.literalPt: Absalão deu ordem aos seus servos, dizendo: Prestai atenção quando o coração de Amnom estiver alegre do vinho e eu vos disser: Feri a Amnom, matai-o. Não tenhais medo, não sou eu quem vô-lo ordena? Sede, pois, corajosos e valentes.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ נַעֲרֵ֤י אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ לְאַמְנ֔וֹן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ׀ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַֽיִּרְכְּב֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־ פִּרְדּ֖וֹ וַיָּנֻֽסוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū na·‘ă·rê ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm lə·’am·nō·wn ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm way·yā·qu·mū kāl- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ way·yir·kə·ḇū ’îš ‘al- pir·dōw way·yā·nu·sū
verses.literal: So Absalom’s young men did to Amnon just as Absalom had ordered Then all the other sons of the king . . . got up and each one fled on his mule
verses.literalPt: Os servos de Absalão fizeram a Amnom como Absalão lhes havia ordenado. Todos os filhos do rei se levantaram, cada um na sua mula, e fugiram.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ הֵ֣מָּה בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְהַשְּׁמֻעָ֣ה בָ֔אָה אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד לֵאמֹ֑ר הִכָּ֤ה אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְלֹֽא־ נוֹתַ֥ר מֵהֶ֖ם אֶחָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî hêm·māh ḇad·de·reḵ wə·haš·šə·mu·‘āh ḇā·’āh ’el- dā·wiḏ lê·mōr hik·kāh ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’eṯ- kāl- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·lō- nō·w·ṯar mê·hem ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: While they were on the way a report reached . . . David . . . Absalom has struck down all the sons of the king not one of them is left
verses.literalPt: Indo eles ainda no caminho, chegou a Davi a nova, dizendo: Absalão matou a todos os filhos do rei, e não ficou deles nem um só.

verses.original: וַיָּ֧קָם הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וַיִּקְרַ֥ע אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֖יו וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב אָ֑רְצָה וְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֥יו נִצָּבִ֖ים קְרֻעֵ֥י בְגָדִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ham·me·leḵ way·yiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·yiš·kaḇ ’ā·rə·ṣāh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm qə·ru·‘ê ḇə·ḡā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Then the king stood up tore his clothes and lay down on the ground And all his servants stood by with their clothes torn
verses.literalPt: Levantou-se o rei, e rasgou os seus vestidos e lançou-se por terra; e todos os seus servos que estavam junto a ele rasgaram os seus vestidos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֡עַן יוֹנָדָ֣ב׀ בֶּן־ שִׁמְעָ֨ה אֲחִֽי־ דָוִ֜ד וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַל־ יֹאמַ֤ר אֲדֹנִי֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַנְּעָרִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הֵמִ֔יתוּ כִּֽי־ אַמְנ֥וֹן לְבַדּ֖וֹ מֵ֑ת כִּֽי־ עַל־ פִּ֤י אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ הָיְתָ֣ה שׂוּמָ֔ה מִיּוֹם֙ עַנֹּת֔וֹ אֵ֖ת תָּמָ֥ר אֲחֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- šim·‘āh ’ă·ḥî- ḏā·wiḏ way·yō·mer ’al- yō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nî ’êṯ kāl- han·nə·‘ā·rîm bə·nê- ham·me·leḵ hê·mî·ṯū kî- ’am·nō·wn lə·ḇad·dōw mêṯ kî- ‘al- pî ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm hā·yə·ṯāh śū·māh mî·yō·wm ‘an·nō·ṯōw ’êṯ tā·mār ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw
verses.literal: But Jonadab the son of David’s brother Shimeah spoke up My lord must not . . . think they have killed all the sons of the king for only Amnon is dead In fact Absalom - has planned this since the day Amnon violated his sister Tamar
verses.literalPt: Jonadabe, filho de Simeia, irmão de Davi, tomou a palavra e disse: Não imagine o meu senhor que mataram todos os mancebos, filhos do rei, porque só morreu Amnom; pois assim o tinha resolvido fazer Absalão desde o dia em que Amnom violou a sua irmã Tamar.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה אַל־ יָשֵׂם֩ אֲדֹנִ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ אֶל־ לִבּוֹ֙ דָּבָ֣ר לֵאמֹ֔ר כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מֵ֑תוּ כִּֽי־ אִם־ אַמְנ֥וֹן לְבַדּ֖וֹ מֵֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- yā·śêm ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ’el- lib·bōw dā·ḇār lê·mōr kāl- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ mê·ṯū kî- ’im- ’am·nō·wn lə·ḇad·dōw mêṯ
verses.literal: So now my lord the king do not take to heart the report that . . . all the sons of the king are dead . . . . . . Only Amnon is dead
verses.literalPt: Agora, não se lhe meta no coração ao rei, meu senhor, o pensar que todos os filhos do rei foram mortos; porque só morreu Amnom.

verses.original: וַיִּבְרַ֖ח אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיִּשָּׂ֞א הַנַּ֤עַר הַצֹּפֶה֙ אֶת־ עֵינוֹ וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֨ה עַם־ רַ֜ב הֹלְכִ֥ים מִדֶּ֛רֶךְ אַחֲרָ֖יו מִצַּ֥ד הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·raḥ ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm way·yiś·śā han·na·‘ar haṣ·ṣō·p̄eh ’eṯ- ʿē·nō way·yar wə·hin·nêh ‘am- raḇ hō·lə·ḵîm mid·de·reḵ ’a·ḥă·rāw miṣ·ṣaḏ hā·hār
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Absalom had fled When the young man standing watch looked up . . . he saw many people coming down the road west of him along the side of the hill. And the watchman went and reported to the king, “I see men coming from the direction of Horonaim, along the side of the hill
verses.literalPt: Fugiu, porém, Absalão. O mancebo que estava de sentinela, levantando os olhos, viu que vinha muita gente pelo caminho, ao lado do monte, por detrás de si.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יֽוֹנָדָב֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בָּ֑אוּ כִּדְבַ֥ר עַבְדְּךָ֖ כֵּ֥ן הָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ’el- ham·me·leḵ hin·nêh ḇə·nê- ham·me·leḵ bā·’ū kiḏ·ḇar ‘aḇ·də·ḵā kên hā·yāh
verses.literal: So Jonadab said to the king Look the sons of the king have arrived It is just as your servant . . . said
verses.literalPt: Jonadabe disse ao rei: Eis aí vêm os filhos do rei; conforme a palavra do teu servo, assim sucedeu.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּכַלֹּת֣וֹ לְדַבֵּ֗ר וְהִנֵּ֤ה בְנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ בָּ֔אוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּ֑וּ וְגַם־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֔יו בָּכ֕וּ בְּכִ֖י גָּד֥וֹל מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw lə·ḏab·bêr wə·hin·nêh ḇə·nê- ham·me·leḵ bā·’ū way·yiś·’ū qō·w·lām way·yiḇ·kū wə·ḡam- ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw bā·ḵū bə·ḵî gā·ḏō·wl mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: And as he finished speaking . . . the sons of the king came in wailing loudly . . . Then the king and all his servants also wept . . . very bitterly
verses.literalPt: Logo que ele tinha acabado de falar, chegaram os filhos do rei e, levantando a voz, choraram; o rei e todos os seus servos também choraram muito.

verses.original: וְאַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בָּרַ֔ח וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ תַּלְמַ֥י בֶּן־ עַמִּיחוּר מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר וַיִּתְאַבֵּ֥ל עַל־ בְּנ֖וֹ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·šā·lō·wm bā·raḥ way·yê·leḵ ’el- tal·may ben- ʿam·mī·ḥūr me·leḵ gə·šūr way·yiṯ·’ab·bêl ‘al- bə·nōw kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Now Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud the king of Geshur But David mourned for his son every day
verses.literalPt: Absalão, porém, fugiu e foi a Talmai, filho de Amiur, rei de Gesur. Davi pranteava a seu filho todos os dias.

verses.original: וְאַבְשָׁל֥וֹם בָּרַ֖ח וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר וַיְהִי־ שָׁ֖ם שָׁלֹ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·šā·lō·wm bā·raḥ way·yê·leḵ gə·šūr way·hî- šām šā·lōš šā·nîm
verses.literal: After Absalom had fled and gone to Geshur he stayed there three years
verses.literalPt: Assim, Absalão fugiu, e foi a Gesur, e ali esteve três anos.

verses.original: וַתְּכַל֙ דָּוִ֣ד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לָצֵ֖את אֶל־ אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם כִּֽי־ נִחַ֥ם עַל־ אַמְנ֖וֹן כִּֽי־ מֵֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḵal dā·wiḏ ham·me·leḵ lā·ṣêṯ ’el- ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm kî- ni·ḥam ‘al- ’am·nō·wn kî- mêṯ
verses.literal: And King David longed to go to Absalom for he had been consoled over Amnon’s . . . death
verses.literalPt: A alma do rei ansiava ir ter com Absalão, porque já se tinha consolado acerca de Amnom, visto que era morto.
